verdict.rationale: Bolna's first-party docs describe an official Bolna MCP server that connects Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, or any MCP client to a Bolna account, and a probe confirms the dedicated documentation page exists. That directly delivers the core of the story, but the pack gives little depth on what the server exposes. Missing for 10: detail on the exposed tools/capabilities and auth/setup flow, independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, or any MCP client to your Bolna account with the Bolna MCP server.
The Bolna MCP server connects your AI assistant directly to your Bolna account over the Model Context Protocol
